title: Pic proper curve divisibility component
statement: Let C be a proper smooth connected dimension-one curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves], with genus g [def-sc-genus], Picard group Pic(C) [def-sc-picard-group], and degree-zero subgroup Pic⁰(C) [def-sc-pic0]. Let n be a natural number whose image in k is nonzero. Then for every L in Pic⁰(C), there is M in Pic⁰(C) with M^n = L (tensor powers).

proof.text: Install the k-scheme structure with structure morphism f. Connectedness and dimension one follow from [def-sc-curves]. Local finite type gives local Noetherianity by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]; smoothness gives regularity by [lem-sc-smooth-regular], and [lem-sc-regular-connected-integral] gives integrality. The irreducible smooth scheme of dimension one has smooth relative dimension one (smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq, the T = Spec k case of [lem-sc-curve-base-change-relative-dimension-one]). Connectedness over the separably closed field gives geometric connectedness by [lem-weil-separably-closed-geometrically-connected]. Every geometric fibre is again connected, smooth, locally Noetherian and regular; applying the same regular-connected-integral argument to these fibres gives geometric integrality. In Lean this is GeometricallyIrreducible.of_smooth_of_geometricallyConnected and GeometricallyIntegral.of_geometricallyReduced_of_geometricallyIrreducible, with the smooth geometric-reducedness instance [sbc-lem-smooth-geometrically-reduced].

Apply [thm-sc-jacobian-representability] in its existing exists_jacobian form, which requires smooth relative dimension one, properness, and geometric integrality. It supplies a representing commutative group scheme J, proper and geometrically integral, smooth of relative dimension the arithmetic genus, and a group equivalence e from picardZero k C to J(k). These geometric properties give IsAbelianVariety J. The subgroup picardZero k C is the kernel of the degree homomorphism, with underlying set f.picZero by Scheme.coe_ker_picDegreeHom [def-sc-pic0]. No dimension or genus comparison is needed to use divisibility.

The nonzero image of n in k implies n > 0, since n = 0 has zero image. Clause (d) of [thm-av-final], formally the third conjunct of abelianVariety_estimate_of_isAlgClosed at p = ringChar k, is surjectivity of the nth power map on J(k). Given L in f.picZero, regard it as an element of picardZero k C and choose a with a^n = e(L). Take M to be the underlying Picard class of e.symm(a). Its subtype property gives membership in f.picZero. The homomorphism identity e((e.symm(a))^n) = a^n and injectivity of e give the equality in the subgroup; congrArg Subtype.val gives M^n = L in C.Pic.

proof_origin.place: Jacobian identification and clause (d) of thm-av-final; geometric integrality via geometric connectedness over a separably closed field. Formal proof by W2.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.pic_proper_ntorsion_div
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : (n : k) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ L : C.Pic, L ∈ f.picZero → ∃ M : C.Pic, M ∈ f.picZero ∧ M ^ n = L
